definitions.explanation: A highly qualified teacher or instructor, especially in martial arts, traditional arts, or crafts. Also used as a title or rank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{師範|しはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おそ}わる→教わる：02024_osowaru⟧。
examples.english: To learn from a kendo master.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{師範|しはん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has been active as a tea ceremony master for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{師範|しはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧おり、⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教|おし}えている→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother holds a master instructor's license in flower arrangement and teaches students at home.

notes:
Composed of {師|し} (teacher, master) + {範|はん} (model, pattern). Carries a sense of authority and mastery. In martial arts and traditional Japanese arts, {師範|しはん} is a formal rank indicating one is qualified to teach independently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {師範|しはん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (master instructor's license)
- {師範|しはん}{代|だい} (assistant instructor, one rank below master)
- {師範|しはん}{学校|がっこう} (normal school, historical teacher training school)
- {師範|しはん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{師事|しじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (study under a master)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ — teacher (general, widely used for any teacher or respected professional)
- ⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧ — instructor, leader (general term without the connotation of traditional mastery)
- ⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧ — master, expert (emphasizes skill rather than teaching role)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional arts like ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧, ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧, and ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧, receiving a {師範|しはん} license is a significant milestone that permits one to teach and award ranks to students.
